name: Bloom compositor service loop and responsiveness

elements.name: bloom compositor reacts to wallpaper watch path

steps.name: the serial output should contain "bloom: service loop started" within 60s
I wait for the shell prompt
I type "echo /share/wallpapers/flower.png > /session/desktop/wallpaper" on the serial console
the serial output should contain "bloom: reacting to wallpaper change" within 60s
